name: Castle Siege 3D
description: Defend your castle wall: enemies march up the valley towards you and you shoot them down with your crossbow.
prompt: A 3D castle defence game with three.js where I stand on the castle wall looking down a valley, soldiers, goblins, knights, ogres and bosses march towards me along the road, I tap to shoot crossbow bolts, and between waves I buy upgrades like more damage, faster reload, multiple bolts, fire bolts and wall repairs.
author: gonzaroman
